card.name: The start of words beginning Ban
card.fires_on: The piece "Ban" or "ban" at the start of a longer word, such as a place name, family name, or "banished". It fires in general web text, not in drug-label text.

modes.label: Names starting Ban
modes.description: Ban opens a place or person name such as Banff, Banfield, Banu or Banach.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are all words for trouble and problems, so it adds no clear meaning.
card.plain: It marks the opening syllable "Ban" in names and in the word banished.
